# opnsense_nodeexporter_settings (Resource)

Prometheus node exporter (**Services ▸ Node Exporter**, plugin `os-node_exporter`). This is a singleton: import it with the ID `nodeexporter_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_nodeexporter_settings.this
  id = "nodeexporter_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_nodeexporter_settings" "this" {
  enabled = true
  cpu     = true
  meminfo = true
  netdev  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cpu` (Boolean) Enable the cpu collector.
- `devstat` (Boolean) Enable the devstat collector.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the Prometheus node exporter.
- `exec` (Boolean) Enable the exec collector.
- `filesystem` (Boolean) Enable the filesystem collector.
- `interrupts` (Boolean) Enable the interrupts collector.
- `listen_address` (String) Address to listen on, `0.0.0.0` for all.
- `listen_port` (Number) Port to listen on. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `loadavg` (Boolean) Enable the loadavg collector.
- `meminfo` (Boolean) Enable the meminfo collector.
- `netdev` (Boolean) Enable the netdev collector.
- `ntp` (Boolean) Enable the ntp collector.
- `time` (Boolean) Enable the time collector.
- `zfs` (Boolean) Enable the zfs collector.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `nodeexporter_settings`.
